items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; informed him he will be inactive Sunday vs DET as details finalized. Trade expected after Sunday games; Houston among teams in mix. MHJ has just 5 catches in 4 games.
items.why: Trade finalizing; team comfortable enough to sit him.
items.implication: Immediate WR void in ARI offense; long-term destination TBD (HOU interest).
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining ARI pass-catchers

items.text: Saquon Barkley listed OUT for Week 5 (hamstring).
items.implication: PHI RB committee shifts; handcuff/backup elevated.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT for Week 5 (ankle).
items.implication: BAL offense without dual-threat QB; backup QB start.
items.opportunity: More designed runs/targets for Henry, Flowers, Andrews/Likely

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr had only 5 catches in 4 games and was not a real factor; his inactive/trade has low impact on Michael Wilson's prior usage. It's Kendrick Bourne season in ARI.
items.why: MHJ volume already minimal; Wilson already producing independently.
items.implication: Wilson remains strong start; Bourne/others get residual targets.

items.text: DeVonta Smith listed OUT for Week 5 (hamstring).
items.implication: PHI WR targets redistribute with Barkley also out.

items.text: Breece Hall listed OUT for Week 5 (quad).
Stefon Diggs listed OUT for Week 5.
items.opportunity: Increased role for McLaurin if active or others

items.text: Quentin Johnston listed OUT for Week 5.
items.implication: LAC WR depth chart shift; McConkey elevated if healthy.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love listed IN for Week 5; not on final injury report despite ankle maintenance.
items.implication: Expected lead RB role vs DET.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love projected 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier; gut says much better role this week despite ankle maintenance and prior low usage criticism. Not on final IR.
items.why: Media/fan pressure on prior usage + cleared report; still some downside risk of limited snaps.
items.implication: Startable RB with clear lead over backup.

items.text: Malik Nabers multi-risk long-term: sore knee (missed practice), lingering shoulder, potential JJ McCarthy QB change, boomer coaching (Harbaugh/Nagy/Roman). Frustrated by low second-half targets last week. Still playable short-term.
items.implication: Monitor closely; high ceiling but volatility rising ROS.
items.opportunity: Target share remains elite when healthy

items.text: Loves Nico Collins heavily vs TEN; ranks him WR8. Volume + soft matchup.
items.why: Target hog vs weak Titans secondary.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; strong workload and matchup. Pushing 'Brown Gobbler' nickname for target/fantasy production.
items.why: Volume + Bengals injury context + soft run defense.

items.text: Loves Michael Wilson vs DET (WR10 range) on volume/RZ; hates Jordan Addison @ NO (WR41) due to tough matchup, thin role, injury wrinkle. Also hates Mark Andrews, Cam Skattebo, Tony Pollard, Jalen Hurts.
items.why: Wilson volume/matchup; hates on efficiency, role, or environment issues.
